Subject: Renewal options — billable capacity swap + limited price hold

Hi Arielle / Marcus,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — appreciated the clarity on your H2 usage patterns and procurement timing. Attached is a short proposal that tries to thread three asks you raised: (1) avoid a hard annual commit increase, (2) preserve a near-term price hold for predictable run rate while you migrate workloads, and (3) give a runway to absorb higher Q4 traffic without a long-term overcommit.

Proposal (high level):
- Annual term with a smaller net commit increase: +15% vs prior year (instead of the +40% you saw in the sizing doc)
- Conditional billable capacity swap: we allow reclassification of up to 25% of the committed GPU hours into a billable "burst bucket" for 6 months. Those hours are priced at a 20% uplift vs committed rate and do not count toward shortfall true-ups for the first quarter.
- 90-day limited price hold on your current unit rate for any additional burst usage between Jan–Mar 2027 (caps at $75k of additional spend).
- One-time onboarding credit: $30k applied as bill credit at start of term to offset migration costs.

I attached the updated SOW draft (v3) and a Q3 usage extract so you can see the fit. If this looks directionally right I can loop in Marissa for approval on the concession and have legal prepare a short addendum we can DocuSign.

Next steps: please confirm (a) does the 25% swap and 6-month window address the short-term burst risk, and (b) is the $30k credit acceptable to procurement? If yes I’ll start the internal approval path today.

Thanks,
David
